plan_boundary.requested_output: Phase 2 的完整 implementation-level XML plan；本輪只產出 plan，不實作。
plan_boundary.phase_name: Semantic assessment intent and framework routing
plan_boundary.authorization: 本文件只規劃 Phase 2。它不授權修改 production code、建立新 branch、commit、push、deployment、live Mongo catalog activation，或開始 Phase 3。implementation 需要 owner 另行明確要求。
plan_boundary.release_boundary: Phase 2 是同一個 feature branch 上的 internal routing slice，不單獨 release。Phase 3 才會讓 Impact-first evaluator 消費這個 route；完整 feature 只在所有 phases 完成後一次 release。

evidence_examined.item: 三輪 research audit、owner alignment、score model、semantic past-example scope，以及已知 contradictions。
Catalog snapshot 目前保留 family/type，但沒有 evidenceMode。
非-catalog item 有 heuristic inference；catalog snapshot 繞過該 inference。
Keyword precedence 在 semantic family 前，且 concrete catalog family 沒有完整 route。
Transcript 已保存 family/evidence/lineage，但沒有 canonical derived assessment intent。
Follow-up targeted contract 已存在；本 phase 保留其 dimensions，只記錄 parent route。
2026.1 catalog taxonomy、prompt、expected signals 與 target levels。
2026.2 與 2026.1 共用 relevant semantic families，新增 ambiguity/clarification metadata。
Catalog eligibility、level variant、version provenance 的既有 test seam。
Transcript metadata、parent lineage、prepared asked-state 的既有 test seam。
Existing STARR, role-specific, scenario, knowledge, credential, self-intro、motivation route assertions。

confirmed_current_state.item: Catalog source uses concrete families such as project_reflection, scenario-like AI/ML questions, and motivation families; report router only recognizes a small canonical subset.
2026.1 and 2026.2 have the same relevant question types and families; 2026.2 adds bounded-scenario/open-scope metadata.
Explicit evidenceMode already travels through pool, interviewer output, and transcript metadata when it exists.
Existing transcript metadata is Mixed and the report dataset retains the question turn, so a bounded derived route needs no migration.
Technical keyword branches can override behavioural family, motivation, or closing semantics; senior wording can trigger this indirectly.
Phase 3 owns Impact-first content evaluation; Phase 2 must establish the route without pretending that STARR or role-specific dimensions are the new evaluator.

gaps.item: Generated/legacy inference defaults too broadly to past_example.
No canonical assessmentIntent is persisted for report routing.
Concrete catalog family and questionType metadata do not consistently select scenario, knowledge, process, or past-example routes.
Follow-up transcript has parent family/evidence fields but no parent assessment route.

weak_reasoning.item: Literal “Tell me about a time” matching treats wording as evidence intent.
Technical keyword presence is incorrectly treated as proof that a question is technical or process-oriented.
Missing evidenceMode is treated as past_example even when the prompt is hypothetical or generic process.
Changing frameworkKey before an evaluator exists would produce a route label with incompatible score dimensions.

unsupported_assumptions.item: 2026.2 is active in the live database; this remains unverified and is non-material because both source versions are tested.
questionType equals final report framework; it is source taxonomy only.
All technical catalog questions are completed past examples; generic workflow questions remain process reasoning.
CapabilityGroup can be safely invented from competency; Phase 2 does not infer it.

assumption_alignment.item: Semantic past-example intent, not literal wording or selected technical topic, owns the new route.
Approaches may be technical or cross-domain; Phase 2 only routes and does not score them.
Old reports, text timing, and separate release are outside the feature boundary.
Existing Mixed transcript metadata can carry a bounded route without a database migration.
Use existing questionFamily/evidenceMode as source contract and add assessmentIntent only at transcript/report routing boundaries; do not invent a second catalog schema.

missing_requirements.item: Stable mode values and a deterministic precedence order.
Explicit current and parent route fields in transcript metadata.
Catalog mappings for both source versions and all current questionType families.
Tests that prove metadata beats technical keywords and senior wording.
A staged boundary that prevents Phase 2 from claiming Phase 3 scoring.

ambiguities.item: Whether to call the derived field frameworkKey or assessmentIntent. Resolved for this plan: assessmentIntent is the route; frameworkKey remains the evaluator-owned field until Phase 3.
Whether to add a new catalog field. Resolved for this plan: no; catalog evidenceMode is derived from existing questionType/category/ambiguity metadata and persisted in the prepared snapshot.
Whether generic technical workflow is past_example. Resolved for this plan: no; use process_reasoning unless explicit metadata requests a completed example.
Whether follow-up targeted dimensions should be redesigned. Resolved for this plan: no; preserve current targeted contract and add parent route provenance.

contradictions.item: Catalog metadata has expectedSignals but no evidenceMode, while report routing treats evidenceMode as a selector.
Concrete family IDs can be stored as questionFamily but are not recognized by the report router.
Senior prompt variants add trade-off/risk words that can change routing without changing assessment intent.
Follow-up contract can reset missing parent mode to past_example; Phase 2 preserves explicit parent route metadata but does not redesign the targeted-dimension contract.

research_gate.questions_that_require_human_answers: None. Live catalog activation is explicitly a non-material operational unknown, not a plan blocker.

phase.name: Semantic assessment intent and framework routing
phase.goal: Make the framework route deterministic from question metadata, persist that route for report consumption, and route every genuine past-example root to assessmentIntent=impact_first_past_example without changing Phase 3 content scoring in this slice.

work_package.name: Canonical metadata resolver
work_package.goal: Define one pure resolver for evidenceMode and assessmentIntent, including explicit source precedence and process_reasoning for generic technical workflows.

work_package.name: Catalog and prepared-pool normalization
work_package.goal: Make catalog snapshots and generated/legacy pool items carry the same explicit evidenceMode without assuming which catalog version is live.

work_package.name: Runtime metadata persistence
work_package.goal: Persist current and parent assessment intent at the existing transcript boundary while preserving root/follow-up IDs, asked-state order, and private-field filtering.

work_package.name: Report routing precedence
work_package.goal: Make inferTurnRubric consume persisted/derived intent first, use wording only for degraded metadata, and keep scenario/knowledge/motivation/self-introduction/credential/conversation routes separate.

work_package.name: Regression evidence and documentation handoff
work_package.goal: Prove the routing matrix and metadata handoff, run package verification, and identify the exact behavior documentation change for the later implementation turn.

task_contract.one_observable_goal: Given complete catalog/pool metadata, the same semantic question family receives the same assessmentIntent across catalog version, seniority wording, technical keyword decoration, interviewer output, transcript metadata, and report routing. Missing metadata uses a deterministic bounded fallback and never silently claims past_example.

forbidden_areas.area: answerFrameworkService dimensions, Impact-first content extraction, five-level anchors, evidence rationale, and content score.
reportScoreService, score denominator, duration composition, scoring version, or overall score.
question wording, follow-up selection policy, catalog seed text, and root/follow-up prompt UX.
catalog seed mutation, live Mongo activation, ranking, eligibility, or question reservation policy.
interviewerAgent, interviewTurnOrchestrator, STT/TTS/VAD, WebSocket, latency, barge-in, or transcript acceptance state machine, unless a test proves an existing field is actually lost.
frontend, public report schema, exports, PDF/TXT, coaching copy, or candidate-facing framework labels.
old-report regeneration, backfill, database migration, or compatibility redesign.

task_contract.stop_rule: If the forecast exceeds 10 task-owned files or 500 incremental lines, or requires a forbidden surface to make the route work, stop before implementation and present a split plan. Do not solve the scope problem by editing an adjacent component without approval.

precedence.rule: An explicit valid evidenceMode from the source item is authoritative.
For catalog items without a mode, use questionType plus ambiguityPolicy before reading prompt wording.
For generated/legacy items without a mode, use explicit questionIntent/category and then bounded text fallback.
A generic technical workflow is process_reasoning; a technical item is not past_example merely because it contains implementation, validation, risk, or trade-off words.
An unresolved generic question returns a deterministic direct/process fallback with a source reason; it is never silently promoted to past_example.

routes.route: A completed experience or project evidence request, including behavioural, conflict, teamwork, learning, failure, initiative, and project reflection.
Hypothetical, bounded scenario, or explicit how-would/if reasoning.
Principle, standard, framework, or explanation request.
Registration, licence, qualification, or credential evidence.
Company, role, career, or transition motivation request.
Generic role/process evidence that is neither hypothetical nor a completed example.
No reliable assessment evidence type remains after bounded fallback.

assessment_intent_contract.follow_up_rule: A follow-up may have targeted dimensions from the existing contract, but its metadata must retain the parent/root assessmentIntent. It does not create another root score or replace the root route with a keyword-derived route.
assessment_intent_contract.seniority_rule: targetLevel and prompt variant may change wording and expected depth, but never assessmentIntent when the source family/questionType/evidenceMode is unchanged.

persistence_contract.follow_up_fields: assessmentIntent, assessmentIntentSource, parentAssessmentIntent, parentAssessmentIntentSource, parentQuestionId, parentPreparedQuestionId, rootQuestionId, followUpIntent, targetedDimensions
persistence_contract.private_fields: Do not spread raw CV, raw job description, provider payload, or unbounded interviewer context.
persistence_contract.migration: None. Existing transcript metadata is Mixed and missing assessmentIntent is reconstructed by the report router.

canonical_contracts.score_boundary: Phase 2 does not change framework dimensions, normalized scores, report score composition, denominator, or duration points. The canonical route is evidence for Phase 3 and is not a user-facing score until the complete feature release.

component.contract: Add small pure helpers rather than duplicating catalog and report regexes. They accept source metadata and return stable values plus a source reason; they do not read Mongo, session state, seniority policy, or report scores.

function.name: resolveCanonicalEvidenceMode
function.inputs: category, questionFamily, questionType, questionIntent, explicit evidenceMode, text, ambiguityMode
function.failure_behavior: Use an explicit deterministic process/direct fallback reason; never throw for a missing optional field.

function.name: resolveQuestionAssessmentIntent
function.inputs: questionFamily, category, questionType, questionIntent, evidenceMode, text, explicit assessmentIntent, parentAssessmentIntent
function.failure_behavior: Return direct_answer with source missing_metadata when no reliable route remains.

component.pseudocode: 1. Normalize every key with the repository's normalizeKey/normalizeText helpers. 2. If a valid explicit assessmentIntent exists, return it with source explicit_metadata. 3. If the caller supplies a parentAssessmentIntent for a follow-up, preserve that route and record source parent_metadata. 4. Normalize family/category aliases: behavioral -> behavioural; opening, motivation, closing, wrap_up, and conversation become their dedicated route families before technical keyword checks run. 5. Resolve explicit evidenceMode. Map past_example to impact_first_past_example; map scenario_reasoning, knowledge_explanation, credential_verification, and process_reasoning to their matching routes. 6. If the source is a catalog item with no explicit mode, classify bounded_scenario and scenario question types as scenario_reasoning; classify behavioural/project-reflection types as past_example; classify explanation/principle types as knowledge_explanation; classify generic workflow types as process_reasoning. 7. Only when source metadata is absent, apply bounded wording fallback for self-introduction, motivation, closing, scenario, knowledge, and genuine past-example phrases. Do not use seniority suffix words as a separate signal. 8. If category is technical and the prompt is a generic present-tense workflow, return process_reasoning. If no category or evidence can be trusted, return direct_answer/missing_metadata. 9. Return the route and source reason. Never return a numeric score or framework dimensions from these helpers.

component.contract: Extend buildCatalogQuestionSnapshots without changing eligibility, ranking, reservation, lifecycle, prompt-variant, or active-version selection rules.

function.name: buildCatalogQuestionSnapshots
function.inputs: selected catalog item, resolved targetLevel, prompt variant, selectionContext
function.output: Existing snapshot plus explicit evidenceMode and bounded metadata source.
function.side_effect: Creates in-memory prepared snapshot only; existing persistence happens downstream.
function.dependencies: resolveCanonicalEvidenceMode, existing catalog eligibility and prompt selection helpers.
function.failure_behavior: Current supported catalog types must resolve deterministically; an unsupported future type must carry a bounded fallback reason and fail the focused matrix rather than silently becoming past_example.

component.pseudocode: 1. Leave catalog query, lifecycle gate, target-level gate, role gate, AI/ML gate, and prompt-variant selection unchanged. 2. After prompt.text and catalogItem fields are known, call resolveCanonicalEvidenceMode with: category=catalogItem.category, questionFamily=catalogItem.questionFamily, questionType=catalogItem.questionType, questionIntent=catalogItem.questionType, text=prompt.text, ambiguityMode=catalogItem.ambiguityPolicy.mode. 3. Add the returned mode to the snapshot's existing evidenceMode field. 4. Add only a bounded source marker under existing safe metadata if needed for diagnostics; preserve catalogQuestionId, catalogVersion, targetLevel, prompt variant, expected signals, and reportDimensions exactly as they are. 5. Do not infer capabilityGroup from competency, do not mutate either seed file, and do not read live Mongo to decide the mode. 6. Return the same items/rejected/selectionContext shape so downstream composition and dedupe contracts remain unchanged.

component.contract: Replace the local broad evidence-mode heuristic with the shared resolver at buildBaseItem. Preserve an explicit source mode and all existing pool fields; do not alter pool ranking, dedupe, question limits, or asked-state reconciliation.

function.name: buildBaseItem
function.inputs: source category, stage, questionIntent, text, explicit evidenceMode, capabilityGroup, existing rest fields
function.output: Existing prepared item with canonical evidenceMode and unchanged assessmentKey/questionFingerprint semantics.
function.dependencies: shared resolver, question artifact helpers, existing buildAssessmentKey/buildQuestionFingerprint.
function.failure_behavior: Missing optional source metadata uses a stable reasoned fallback; no exception and no silent past-example promotion.

component.pseudocode: 1. Preserve the current input destructuring and explicit rest fields. 2. Pass category, questionFamily, questionType/questionIntent, text, capabilityGroup, and rest.evidenceMode to the shared resolver. 3. Use the returned mode for the item.evidenceMode field before the existing ...rest merge; if an explicit valid mode was supplied, ensure the merge cannot replace it with a default. 4. Keep questionFamily resolution, questionRole, followUpStrategies, weights, modeCompatibility, retention, and source provenance unchanged unless required to preserve the resolved mode. 5. Recompute assessmentKey/questionFingerprint from the same item fields as before; do not add wording or seniority to framework identity. 6. Run the existing composer suite to prove legacy v2/current v3, dedupe, fallback, and prepared-root compatibility.

component.contract: Extend buildQuestionTranscriptMetadata and the append metadata object with current and parent route fields. Keep the existing prepared asked-state and selection-trace ordering unchanged.

function.name: buildQuestionTranscriptMetadata
function.inputs: bounded interviewerOutput including family, category, type, evidenceMode, parent fields, turn kind, and safe provenance
function.output: Existing metadata plus assessmentIntent, assessmentIntentSource, parentAssessmentIntent, parentAssessmentIntentSource.
function.failure_behavior: Current route falls back deterministically; parent route remains null when no parent metadata exists. Private fields remain excluded.

function.name: persistInterviewerQuestionTurn
function.output: Existing transcript append result and returned interviewer output.
function.side_effect: Writes one AI transcript turn; may update prepared root asked-state exactly as before.
function.failure_behavior: Asked-state failure continues to append transcript and suppresses selection trace according to the existing contract; route fields do not alter that behavior.

component.pseudocode: 1. Keep resolveQuestionTurnType, countsAsQuestion, parentQuestionId fallback, createInterviewQuestion, and asked-state sequencing unchanged. 2. In buildQuestionTranscriptMetadata, resolve the current assessmentIntent from the bounded current question fields. 3. If parentQuestionFamily or parentEvidenceMode exists, resolve parentAssessmentIntent separately; do not use current follow-up wording to overwrite it. 4. Add only the four bounded route fields to the returned metadata object. Do not spread raw interviewerOutput. 5. Let the existing append metadata spread carry those fields to SessionTranscript.turns[].metadata. 6. Keep preparedQuestionId, parentPreparedQuestionId, parentQuestionId, rootQuestionId, followUpIntent, targetedDimensions, asked-state, and selection trace behavior unchanged. 7. Verify the report dataset can read the persisted metadata without a schema migration or a new report-publication field.

component.contract: Make inferTurnRubric metadata-first. Every returned rubric carries assessmentIntent and its source. Existing frameworkKey, dimensions, and score-producing branches remain compatible until Phase 3 consumes the new route.

function.name: inferTurnRubric
function.caller: analyzeTurnStructure and report deterministic turn breakdowns
function.inputs: question text, persisted transcript metadata, current/parent family and evidence mode, follow-up intent
function.output: Existing rubric shape plus assessmentIntent and assessmentIntentSource; current compatible scoring branch remains until Phase 3.
function.dependencies: resolveQuestionAssessmentIntent, existing framework builders, existing follow-up contract.
function.failure_behavior: Missing metadata uses the bounded resolver and returns direct or process route; no keyword-only promotion to Impact-first.

component.pseudocode: 1. Normalize question text and read metadata.assessmentIntent first. 2. Resolve current route from persisted assessmentIntent or canonical family/evidence/type metadata. 3. Resolve parentAssessmentIntent from persisted parent route or parent family/evidence fields when this is a follow-up. 4. Handle follow-up targeted dimensions using the existing resolveFollowUpAssessmentContract. Attach the parent route to the returned rubric; do not create another root score and do not change the existing targeted-dimension map in this phase. 5. For root routes, choose dedicated self-intro, motivation, conversation, credential, scenario, knowledge, or role-specific builders from assessmentIntent. For impact_first_past_example, keep the old analyzer-compatible carrier only as an internal non-release bridge; expose assessmentIntent=impact_first_past_example and source metadata for Phase 3. 6. Remove the old early technical-keyword return that ran before semantic family/evidence routing. Technical words are fallback evidence only. 7. Keep validateRubricQuestionAlignment and all current score/dimension formulas unchanged unless a focused test proves the route field is lost. 8. Return a stable source reason so tests and later audit can distinguish persisted metadata from degraded text fallback.

data_flow.step: 2026.1 or 2026.2 catalog item, or generated/legacy question source, provides category/family/type/intent/text.
Shared resolver produces explicit evidenceMode; catalog snapshot or prepared item carries it.
Existing interviewer carrier passes family/evidence/parent/provenance fields; no new LLM decision is introduced.
masterAiService derives current assessmentIntent and parentAssessmentIntent and writes bounded transcript metadata.
Report dataset keeps the AI question turn and its metadata; turnRubricService reads persisted route first.
Scenario, knowledge, credential, self-intro, motivation, conversation, and role/process routes keep existing compatible analyzers; past-example turns expose Impact-first route intent for Phase 3.
No Phase 2 operation changes duration, content score, denominator, overall score, frontend, or candidate publication.

cases.case: Parameterize equivalent 2026.1 and 2026.2 catalog items and assert explicit evidenceMode for behavioural/project, scenario, knowledge/process, motivation, and credential families.
Assert bounded_scenario selects scenario_reasoning even when prompt contains technical terms.
Assert junior/intermediate/senior prompt variants with the same source metadata produce the same evidenceMode.
Assert catalogVersion and prompt provenance remain unchanged.
Root metadata persists assessmentIntent=impact_first_past_example for explicit past_example mode.
Root metadata persists scenario/knowledge/motivation/self-intro routes without private-field leakage.
Follow-up metadata persists parentAssessmentIntent, parent/root IDs, followUpIntent, and targetedDimensions without creating a prepared-root asked-state update.
Missing metadata returns a stable direct/process fallback and never a hidden candidate zero.
Parameterize semantic past-example prompts: project reflection, teamwork, conflict, learning, failure, initiative, and non-literal “Have you been...” wording.
Assert explicit behavioural/past-example metadata wins over implementation, validation, trade-off, risk, and senior wording.
Assert scenario, knowledge, credential, self-intro, motivation, conversation, and process routes remain separate.
Assert the same metadata plus junior/senior wording has the same assessmentIntent and source.
Keep existing compatible frameworkKey/dimension assertions green until Phase 3 changes the evaluator owner.

tests.existing_suite: Run as a required regression suite. Do not modify it unless a concrete Phase 2 failure cannot be covered in the three forecast test files.

commands.command: git diff --name-only -- backend/src frontend/src | rg 'frontend|voice|score|coaching|export' ; expected result: empty

observable_outcomes.outcome: Focused routing, catalog, persistence, and composer suites pass without real provider credentials.
Backend lint and diff check pass.
Assessment route is identical for equivalent source metadata across both catalog versions and seniority variants.
Explicit metadata route is unchanged by technical keyword decoration.
Transcript metadata contains current/parent route fields and existing lineage fields; no private source fields are added.
Diff contains no frontend, voice runtime, score-composition, coaching, export, seed, or live-activation change.

verification.not_run: Live Mongo catalog activation, real AI/provider evaluation, browser/manual interview, frontend rendering, text timing, production deployment, and release verification are not run for Phase 2.

completion_criteria.criterion: All current 2026.1 and 2026.2 catalog question types receive a deterministic evidenceMode in the prepared snapshot.
Every semantic past-example root, including non-literal and non-technical examples, exposes assessmentIntent=impact_first_past_example.
Scenario, knowledge, credential, self-introduction, motivation, conversation, and generic process routes remain distinct.
Explicit family/evidence metadata beats technical keywords, seniority suffixes, and prompt wording.
Generated and legacy questions use the same resolver; unknown generic technical questions do not silently become past_example.
Current and parent assessment intent are persisted in bounded transcript metadata and remain available to report input.
Follow-up targeted dimensions and asked-state sequencing remain unchanged; follow-up does not become another root score.
No Phase 3 evaluator, Phase 4 score composition, duration score, frontend, public schema, seed, live catalog, or voice-runtime behavior is changed.
All three modified test files plus the existing composer suite, backend lint, diff check, and forbidden-path inspection pass.
One owning RFC and one scoped change-log entry are updated only during the implementation turn, after verified behavior exists.

risks_assumptions_decisions.decision: Use questionFamily/evidenceMode as the source contract and assessmentIntent as a derived transcript/report route; do not add a second catalog schema field.
Add process_reasoning for generic present-tense technical workflows so technical topic does not imply completed past evidence.
Metadata has precedence over wording. Wording is a bounded degraded fallback only.
Keep existing follow-up targeted dimensions and preserve parent route provenance; redesigning follow-up scoring belongs to later phases.
Keep frameworkKey and score-compatible analyzer shape until Phase 3 consumes assessmentIntent. No intermediate user-facing release exists.
Do not infer capabilityGroup from competency or prompt wording; absent capability remains absent.
risks_assumptions_decisions.assumption: Existing interviewer output already carries family, evidenceMode, parent fields, and catalog provenance; no interviewerAgent edit is forecast.
Report dataset preserves question metadata through pairing, and transcript metadata is Mixed.
Semantic past-example scope includes teamwork, conflict, learning, failure, initiative, project reflection, and technical completed examples only when the source asks for completed evidence.
The active live catalog version is unknown; both inspected source versions are supported instead.
risks_assumptions_decisions.risk: Older transcripts lack assessmentIntent. Mitigation: reconstruct from persisted family/evidence, then bounded wording fallback, and label the source.

A new mode could accidentally change an existing generic technical route. Mitigation: preserve explicit modes, test process_reasoning, run the full existing composer suite, and keep Phase 3 score code untouched.

A route label without an evaluator could be mistaken for a score. Mitigation: keep Phase 2 internal, retain analyzer-compatible carrier shape, and explicitly defer frameworkKey/evaluator cutover to Phase 3.
Mixed metadata can drift again. Mitigation: centralize the resolver, bounded persistence, and cross-layer tests; do not broaden the schema in this phase.

outside_scope.item: Implementing or scoring the seven Impact-first components, including Outcome-first placement and 90-120-second duration points.
Changing reportScoreService, report denominator, normalized score, score explanation, or rubric version.
Changing catalog seeds, question wording, follow-up selection, ranking, eligibility, reservations, or live Mongo state.
Changing interviewer runtime, voice state machine, STT/TTS/VAD, latency, transcript confidence, or text timing.
Changing frontend, candidate report cards, coaching, PDF/TXT exports, or public schemas.
Backfilling, regenerating, migrating, or recalibrating old reports.
Running live provider, browser, human calibration, deployment, or production checks.
